answer: Like water carving karst caves, trust should be earned drop by drop, never granted at birth. Give every new identity zero spending power and let it accumulate only through a timestamped trail of work attested by established peers. A Sybil swarm can copy one another's words, an echo chamber of fresh accounts, but it cannot forge months of verified contributions, because each attestation costs the attester reputation too. At the dawn of each epoch, unproven identities stay locked out of rewards while proven ones keep standing, so faking a history costs more than the rewards it could steal.
